held_back: Lauritz Hansen has the strongest construction link but no verified publishable identity portrait was found.
Carl Berner and Gjøril Songvoll remain relevant runtime people but do not replace the restoration-layer anchor.

source_conflicts.claim: Høyesterett holdt til i Gamle rådhus fra 1815.
source_conflicts.reason: 1815 is the court's founding year; the detailed site source dates the stay in this building to 1821–1846.

source_conflicts.claim: Dagens gavler og restaurantinteriør er urørte originaler.
source_conflicts.reason: The gables were restored in the twentieth century and the 1926 interior was reconstructed after the 1996 fire.

manual_image_review.note: All crops were inspected together; later photos are labelled as later evidence rather than depictions of 1641 or untouched 1926 fabric.

correctness_and_evidence.note: Four inspectable historical sources plus four image pages; the 1815/1821 boundary and reconstruction status are explicit.

coverage_and_completion.note: Four image-ready collections, fifteen milestones, People claims, language, Story, reading tracks, History A–H and 4x7 quiz are materialized.

editorial_quality.note: The account distinguishes civic institution from democracy, original fabric from restoration, and the building from the square.

technical_integrity.note: Deterministic finalizer, canonical manifests, local assets, v4.2 packet and targeted test are included.

safety_and_responsibility.note: Limited representation and coercive arrest use are visible; sources are not used to invent marginalized users' experiences.

maintainability_and_auditability.note: Claims, sentence mapping, image provenance, source conflict, holdbacks and permanent tests provide a reproducible audit trail.
